wstep: There is no recipe here for fresh white sausage with onion, baked in jars in the oven (Polish biała kiełbasa).

ostrzezenia.tekst: Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning meat, poultry, seafood and vegetables; using a boiling-water bath for these foods poses a real risk of botulism poisoning.
According to NCHFP, open-kettle canning and processing filled jars in an oven, a microwave oven or a dishwasher are not recommended, because these practices do not prevent all risks of spoilage.
According to UC ANR, oven canning is extremely hazardous.

akapity: Red meats and poultry are low-acid foods.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for canning white sausage in jars from a checked source.
